title: a2a server does not return liveOutput for ExecutingToolCall or resultsDisplay for result values
body:
### What happened?

A2A server is filtering almost all result values from scheduled tool results.  This happens in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/packages/a2a-server/src/agent/task.ts#L446-L456.  Based on the comment it seems like the fields that should be serialized should be allow listed.  This change breaks being able to display errors and tool execution output to users.

### What did you expect to happen?

Requisite fields would be returned by the server.

### Client information

linked_prs.title: Fix: A2A server - add liveOutput and response resultsDisplay to the serialized tool call result (closes #9520)
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

This change fixes #9520 by adding the appropriate fields.  It also adds key
typing to the previous string based key checking algorithm to ensure that these
are added without typos and casts to the proper inferred return types.

## Reviewer Test Plan

This requires a link to a downstream consumer.  This was tested through changes to the private A2A implementation first.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns the agent's tool invocation and result serialization logic, specifically the filtering of result values from scheduled tool executions. It directly affects tool execution output and error display, which falls under "Tool implementation errors" and "Tool configuration issues" in the agent issue taxonomy.
